summary: Practise ownership checks, bid-rigging red flags, sanctions screening, and control design. Explore the procurement integrity risk course.
lede: Procurement integrity and collusion-risk training helps procurement, compliance, audit, grant, and investigation professionals assess risks in public or donor-funded tenders. Participants practise reviewing case files, checking beneficial-ownership and conflict-of-interest records, and spotting bid-rigging indicators in tender data. Exercises also cover sanctions-screening escalation and control roadmaps; AI-assisted anomaly detection is introduced at awareness level, not as a system to deploy.
audienceIntro: This course is designed for professionals who assess, approve, monitor, or investigate public and donor-funded procurement. It suits people who need to turn tender concerns into documented checks, decisions, and escalation records.
modules: Procurement Case Files and Investigation Records
prerequisites: Recommended: working familiarity with procurement processes, tender documentation, or contract administration. No programming is required. Bring a laptop with access to Excel for spreadsheet-based exercises; use only non-confidential information in any personal practice materials.
